items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was doing a movie for Fox under the direction of Lionel Newman

ctx.x: No. I was doing a movie for Fox under the direction of Lionel Newman and there was a spot in there they wanted Rafael Mendez to play. And I told him, “I’d sure would like to play like you play, know a finer point of the trumpet.” And he said, “I’d like to play like you play.” So, that’s all that ever happened to that. And I did go to a teacher here one time. I wanted to learn how to sight read. He was recommended to me by Manny Klein. And I made an appointment and I went to see him and naturally he had me to play…
